content.value: An industrial pipe line containing ammonia gas is vented to ambient air to maintain 17 a pressure close to 1 atmosphere. Venting is done by tapping the pipe and inserting a 4 mm diameter tube which extends for 25 m into the atmosphere. With the entire system operating at $3 0 \mathrm { { } ^ { \circ } C }$ , determine the mass rate of ammonia lost to atmosphere.
